name: P-TOKEN-02B approved contextual text export

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - architecture/p-token-02b-contextual-copy-20261022
    paths:
      - "decisions.json"
      - "scripts/export-approved-contextual-text.mjs"
      - "tests/export-approved-contextual-text.test.mjs"
      - "dist/approved-contextual-support-text.*"
      - ".github/workflows/p-token-02b-contextual-export.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  contextual:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Syntax check
        run: |
          node --check scripts/export-approved-contextual-text.mjs
          node --check tests/export-approved-contextual-text.test.mjs
      - name: Source-pinned export check
        run: node scripts/export-approved-contextual-text.mjs --check
      - name: Contextual scope and determinism
        run: node --test tests/export-approved-contextual-text.test.mjs
